items.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
items.summary_short: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys. There was no announcement of a major breakthrough, after Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner travelled to Kyiv.

items.title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
items.summary_short: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport. Five people are dead and five seriously injured after a Boeing 767-300 cargo plane "overran" the runway and caught fire, officials say.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD hails big victory in east, but falls short of majority

items.title: Australians will be able to switch off social media algorithms under planned legislation

items.title: Six dead and more feared trapped in collapsed building in Delhi
